Falha Dupla de Motor

A critical emergency situation where both engines of a multi-engine aircraft cease functioning in flight.

Questions and answers

What is Falha Dupla de Motor?

In this glossary, Falha Dupla de Motor refers to: A critical emergency situation where both engines of a multi-engine aircraft cease functioning in flight.

How is Falha Dupla de Motor used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Mayday mayday mayday, temos uma falha dupla de motor, tentando planar até o aeródromo mais próximo."

Definition

A critical emergency situation where both engines of a multi-engine aircraft cease functioning in flight.

Operational example

Mayday mayday mayday, we have a double engine failure, attempting to glide to nearest suitable airfield.

Localized term

Localized example
